question: The object in the British Museum's collection with a museum number of 2012,5015.17 is the shell of a particular mollusk species. According to the abstract of a research article published in Science Advances in 2021, beads made from the shells of this species were found that are at least how many thousands of years old?

Suggest searching for the article title "Early Middle Stone Age personal ornaments from Bizmoune Cave, Morocco" and reading the abstract.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: WebSurfer, please open the Science Advances article "Early Middle Stone Age personal ornaments from Bizmoune Cave, Morocco" and read the abstract. We need the exact minimum age phrasing in thousands of years for beads made from Tritia/Nassarius gibbosula shells.
